title: Azusawa Kohane — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And there you have it! Our special birthday song, from us to Kohane♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you so much, An, Luka! That was wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was surprised when you suddenly started singing along with KAITO's music... But it was an excellent song, full of appreciation for Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A surprise... Yeah, you can say that again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, KAITO's DJing just makes you want to hop in!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for backing me up, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No problem. I had a lot of fun! It was nice sending some extra happiness Kohane's way!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! The party's really warmed up, thanks to you two.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right? And so, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think it's time for the you-know-what!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Attention, please! Eyes on me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, what's this? What's going on?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You see...
We have a special birthday message, addressed right to Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A birthday message? Who could it be from?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh... Aren't you excited to find out?
Okay, I'm pressing play!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Here we go, everyone! One, two, three!>

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Kohane!>
<Happy birthday, Kohane.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <I never thought I'd be sending a message to a friend all the way across the world like this.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Yeah. It's a strange feeling.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <It was a big shock, hearing you'd be going to the US to see an event! But it definitely feels like the kind of thing you'd do.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <You're a lot bolder than you seem, after all.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <How are things in the United States? I'm sure you're having a wonderful time with An and the others.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Here's hoping your time there ends up being a great experience! We're all rooting for you!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <We'll have another party waiting when you get home. Everyone else in class is looking forward to it too.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <That'll be it from us! Happy birthday again, Kohane! See you soon!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They all recorded a message for me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I asked if they would like to, and everyone jumped at the chance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But just wait... There's more!
Time for video #2!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Ena
rows.Line: <Happy birthday.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hiya, Kohane! Here's a special message for you, all the way from Japan♪ What's it like celebrating your birthday over there? Having a good time?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I can't really imagine what it must feel like to celebrate your birthday in another country.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, me neither. I hope it's a good day all the same.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! Make sure you get An and the boys to celebrate you a whole bunch!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If Akito gets annoying about it, feel free to yell at him all you like.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me? You're the annoying one here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come on, don't argue with a video.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Anyway, forget about him...
I hope you enjoy your time in the US, Azusawa.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <When you get home, bring An and let's go hang out somewhere! Happy birthday again!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Happy birthday again. See you.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, she runs her mouth even in a video...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I never expected to get a message from Ena and the others.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And now, last but not least... It's a message from your favorite troupe!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, there's even more?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Kohane! Happy wonderhoy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Are you faring well in America? Braving the world to chase after your dream is a truly admirable thing!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <It's a pity we can't see you in person, but I'm glad to have this chance to convey our well-wishes all the same.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Right. I hope our feelings can reach you through the screen.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <We're already thinking of what kind of birthday show we'll welcome you home with☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <We hope you really, reaaally look forward to it♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Now then... Let's make sure our cheer for Azusawa makes it all the way across the grand Pacific!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
<Yeah! Here we go!
Happy birthdaaay... Wonderhoy!>

rows.Speaker: Nene, Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line: <Wonderhoy!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Ha ha ha ha! Let us meet again in Japan!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <See you soon, Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that concludes our little video segment! Applause, if you please!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So many messages...
Thank you all so much! I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad you liked it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. Especially after all the effort Shiraishi put into this plan.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An did?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She reached out to basically everyone we know, asking them for messages. Anything to make you happy, she said.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? Thank you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, it's the least I could do for my amazing partner's birthday! Seeing you happy makes it all worth it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now that the surprise is settled, why don't we have some cake?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! What a colorful cake!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This is MEIKO's special birthday cake! It's a real feast for the eyes, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is astounding. Pink sponge cake, with yellow and blue frosting?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's an American-style birthday party, after all, so I went with a cake you wouldn't see in Japan. I'm told ones like this are popular in the US.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We helped bake the cake and put on the frosting!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It might look a little weird, but I can guarantee it's delicious.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I never thought I'd get to have such a wonderful party in the US.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kohane. You're off to see the world in pursuit of your dream... When I think of how brave you are, it makes me want to work harder, too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: First you land that big event, and now you're off around the world. You really are such a cool person.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll always support you and your dream, Kohane. I can't wait to hear you sing again soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let me know when you're back in Japan! We'll throw you a party to make up for missing it today. Happy birthday, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for sending us a reply to our video message! That pizza really was huge, wasn't it? It looked like one slice was the size of my face!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that was a real shock. Did you manage to eat the whole thing...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, I know it's your dream, but going all the way to the US takes some real initiative. Make sure to keep an eye on your health, and have fun over there!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kohane. Isn't it wonderful to be able to share these happy feelings even though we're so far apart? I'm so glad you enjoyed our birthday message!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kohane. When you're back in Japan, let's go somewhere with An and Minori. I'd love to hear all about your trip then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kohane!
That American-style party sounds like it was a ton of fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I heard that An really went all-out. I hope you liked our message!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We just got your thank-you message earlier. It sounds like you did, so I'd call it a success. And it sounds like you're having a good time over there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. I can't really picture what it must be like over there... But I hope it's a good experience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kohane! I sent a happy happy happy birthday beam all the way to America earlier. Did it make it there?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was a little surprised when Shiraishi reached out to us... But I'm glad we were able to send you our message.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's a very special birthday show waiting for you when you return! Feel free to ramp up your excitement now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We're all eagerly practicing and waiting for the chance to make you smile, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kohane! I'm so happy you enjoyed your party so much. It made all of my hard work worth it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And then you made such a basic mistake on the day of.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Urk... J-Just call that a happy accident!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, let's keep on making all sorts of memories together. I'm sure there are things we can only see and experience here in the US, after all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. And those memories will spur us on to greater heights. Let's see even more of the world together, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, what they said. Let's soak in everything we can, so we have some good stories to tell when we get back to Japan.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: With you by my side, I feel like I could go anywhere and everywhere. So...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's keep on moving forward together, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What a special day today has been.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so far away from everything I know, but there are still people who think of me and wish me well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And their thoughts and feelings make my heart feel so full.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm going to keep singing, to respond to those feelings lifting me up...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I'll keep on moving forward, too. I hope you'll watch over me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for all the birthday wishes. See you again!
